comment: Add attribute-tokens support to NAA (NestedAppAuthAdapter serializes sorted-space-joined attributeTokens onto TokenRequest), Native Broker (PlatformAuthInteractionClient/PlatformAuthRequest passthrough), and BrowserCacheManager.generateCredentialKey (appends persisted additionalCacheKeyComponentsHash for cache-key partition isolation) [#8700](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8700)
